column1: # Reviewed allow-list for the existing-Mac settings rehearsal.
# path<TAB>format<TAB>requirement
# The format is json, jsonc, toml, or text. A text input is copied verbatim
# only when it holds no credential-shaped value; otherwise the rehearsal fails
# closed or omits the file and counts it.
# The rehearsal reads only these files. Authentication stores, session files,
# history databases, and every other tree stay on the device: `.claude.json`
# holds the OAuth account and the user MCP fields, `auth.json` holds client
# credentials, and the Atuin stores hold shell history. The helper refuses a
# manifest that names any of them.
# The requirement column marks an input the rehearsal cannot proceed without
# (required) or one the device may not have (optional).
# A field whose name says that it holds an integrity value (the last segment
# is hash, digest, checksum, fingerprint, sha, sha256, sha512, or comp_hash)
# is not a credential: a hook trust digest carries no secret and is projected
# as it is, so the projection can prove that the deployment preserves it. A
# credential-named field stays redacted whatever its value is.
